sections.title: Sharp Higher Integrability Theory, Part I: The Lp-norm of the Beurling--Ahlfors transform
sections.abstract: Claims the sharp Lp norm formula for the Beurling--Ahlfors transform, confirming Iwaniec's conjecture.
sections.claimed_result: The authors claim the norm is p-1 for p>=2 and (p-1)^-1 for 1<p<=2.
sections.caveat: Part I preprint; proof requires expert verification.

sections.title: Isolated singularities of solutions to the Yamabe equation in higher dimensions I
sections.abstract: Claims classification of isolated singularities of positive Yamabe solutions in dimensions 3 through 29.
sections.claimed_result: Every isolated singularity is removable or asymptotic to a Fowler solution.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Positive Yamabe-equation solutions in the Riemannian setting, dimensions 3<=n<=29.
sections.caveat: Counterexamples for n>=30 are deferred to a subsequent paper.

sections.title: On the multicolour Ramsey numbers R(3,3,k)
sections.abstract: Claims R(3,3,k)=Theta(k^3/(log k)^2) and fixed-colour extensions.
sections.claimed_result: Determines the Ramsey number up to a constant factor.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Asymptotic k with fixed number of colours.
sections.caveat: Constants and detailed thresholds are not given in the abstract.

sections.title: A counterexample to Fuchs's conjecture
sections.abstract: Constructs entire functions disproving Fuchs's conjecture.
sections.claimed_result: For every rho in (0,1/2), constructs an entire function whose logarithmic derivative has zero as a deficient value.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Entire functions of order rho in (0,1/2).
sections.caveat: Consequences for related value-distribution questions are not developed in the abstract.

sections.title: Global well-posedness and scattering for mass-critical Hartree equation
sections.abstract: Claims global well-posedness and scattering at mass-critical regularity without radial restrictions.
sections.claimed_result: Defocusing L2 data scatter; focusing data scatter below ground-state mass.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Mass-critical Hartree equation, with the stated defocusing/focusing mass conditions.
sections.caveat: Exact kernel and threshold conventions require the full paper.

sections.title: Stochastic Domination of Gaussian Maxima by the Regular Simplex
sections.abstract: Claims an all-threshold Gaussian-maxima comparison with the regular simplex and an information-theoretic application.
sections.claimed_result: Proves stochastic domination and characterizes equality under equicorrelation.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Centered unit-variance Gaussian vectors and the regular-simplex comparison.
sections.caveat: Lean artifact and analytic correspondence were not audited here.

sections.title: A Spectral Proof of Khachiyan's Ellipsoid Conjecture
sections.abstract: Claims the sharp central-halfspace cut bound for maximum-volume inscribed ellipsoids.
sections.claimed_result: Proves the optimal sqrt(e)/2 bound and gives sharpness and near-equality results.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Convex bodies and central cuts through the center of a maximum-volume inscribed ellipsoid.
sections.caveat: AI-assisted discovery is reported; independent expert review remains necessary.

sections.title: Chvátal's conjecture: a proof from The Book
sections.abstract: Gives a short direct spectral proof of Chvátal's conjecture and a strengthening.
sections.claimed_result: Proves the downset intersecting-family conjecture and proposes two spectral variants.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Downsets and intersecting subfamilies, with stars as the conjectured extremizers.
sections.caveat: The proposed spectral conjectures are not claimed proved.
